name: Adaptation Fund
collect_note: No call list or fixed deadline exists: proposals are accepted at any time on a rolling basis. The program page is watched twice a day and any change to it is flagged for review. No deadlines are collected.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET 2026-11-12, desktop UA, 30 s: program page HTTP 200 (158,720 bytes, labeled 'Call for Proposals', rolling wording not on this page but 'twice a year' Board consideration and 'next submission deadline' pointer to the calendar); /apply-funding/ HTTP 200 (states 'Submissions for all funding windows are now accepted on a rolling basis (Decision B.40/59)'); /feed/ HTTP 200 (news only, latest 2026-11-10); /wp-json/wp/v2/types HTTP 401; /wp-json/wp/v2/pages/38731 HTTP 401; /calendar/ HTTP 200 (not parsed for dated calls); /apply-funding/innovation-grants/innovation-proposals/ HTTP 404.
page_reason: The Adaptation Fund now accepts proposals for all funding windows on a rolling basis (Board decision B.40/59, stated on /apply-funding/), so Large Innovation Projects has no per-round deadline or call list to read. The program page only says 'the next submission deadline can be found under Apply for Funding and on the calendar', and neither shows a current dated deadline.
